copy.announcement: A perfume brand shaped by memory
copy.brand.name: Zahrat al Oud
copy.hero.description: Inspired by the warmth of oud and the beauty of what endures. Zahrat al Oud is a perfume brand in the making.
copy.story.label: The house of Zahrat al Oud
copy.story.paragraphOne: Oud has always been more than a note. It is a welcome, a memory carried home, a quiet presence that lingers long after the moment has passed.
copy.story.paragraphTwo: Zahrat al Oud brings that enduring spirit into a contemporary world. A considered perfume brand, guided by heritage and an appreciation for the details that make a feeling last.
copy.values.0.label: 01 / Origin
copy.values.0.title: Rooted in heritage
copy.values.0.description: Inspired by the traditions and stories that have always made oud feel like home.
copy.values.1.label: 02 / Intention
copy.values.1.title: Made with meaning
copy.values.1.description: Every detail begins with a feeling worth remembering, and the care to honour it.
copy.values.2.label: 03 / Presence
copy.values.2.title: Here to linger
copy.values.2.description: A modern point of view on the quiet confidence of a scent that stays with you.

arabicCopy.hero.description: مستوحاة من دفء العود وجمال الأثر الباقي. زهرات العود علامة عطور تحمل حكاية من الأصالة.
arabicCopy.story.label: دار Zahrat al Oud
arabicCopy.story.paragraphOne: العود أكثر من مجرد نغمة عطرية؛ إنه ترحيب وذكرى تعود معك إلى المنزل، وحضور هادئ يبقى أثره بعد انقضاء اللحظة.
arabicCopy.story.paragraphTwo: تقدم Zahrat al Oud روح العود الخالدة برؤية معاصرة، مستلهمة من إرثنا ومحتفية بالتفاصيل التي تجعل المشاعر باقية.
